dependency_target_status_semantics.READY_means: All antecedent prerequisite edges in the declarative DAG evaluation path are satisfied; the target node is structurally eligible for evaluation.
dependency_target_status_semantics.BLOCKED_means: One or more antecedent prerequisite edges in the DAG failed, unresolved, or cycle detected; target node evaluation cannot proceed.
dependency_target_status_semantics.UNRESOLVED_means: Prerequisites are missing, cyclic, or have indeterminate evaluation state.
dependency_target_status_semantics.relation_to_governance_output: Dependency DAG target readiness (READY) reflects structural DAG eligibility only. GovernanceDecisionEngine independently enforces the conjunction of active blocker count (must be 0) and evidence completeness (no NOT_ESTABLISHED/STALE/REVOKED), deriving final governance status BLOCKED.

theorem_semantics.dependency_eligibility: Evaluated through DAG edges; denotes predicate input availability.
theorem_semantics.theorem_evaluation_outcome: Outcome of formal mathematical or empirical evaluation.
theorem_semantics.theorem_authority_state: Ratified authoritative governance state; eligible != established.
